# IOGAI

> Appliance and refrigeration repair for homes and businesses across Huntington Beach, Orange
> County, and LA. 10+ years of experience, 5.0 average rating on Google (137 reviews).

## About
IOGAI is an appliance and refrigeration repair company founded by Igor Ogai, serving Orange
County and LA. IOGAI repairs residential and commercial refrigerators and freezers, high-end built-ins
(Sub-Zero, Viking, Thermador, Wolf, Miele), ice machines, reach-ins, prep tables, bar
coolers, washers, dryers, ovens, and dishwashers.

## Service area
Huntington Beach, Orange County, and Los Angeles.

## Services
- Refrigerator & Freezer Repair - residential and commercial units.
- Commercial Refrigeration & Restaurant Equipment - ice machines, reach-ins, prep tables, bar coolers.
- Built-In & High-End Appliance Repair - Sub-Zero, Viking, Thermador, Wolf, Miele.
- Medical, Lab & Beauty Refrigeration - pharmacy and vaccine refrigerators, lab and ultra-low freezers, blood bank and specimen refrigerators, mortuary refrigerators, cooling systems in aesthetic clinic devices (plug-in equipment; no X-ray or radiation equipment). https://iogai.com/medical-lab-beauty-refrigeration
- General Appliance Repair - washers, dryers, ovens, and dishwashers.

## Why customers choose us
- 10+ years repairing systems of any complexity.
- 5.0/5 average rating across 137 Google reviews.
- Certified technicians, swift response, service warranty on repairs.
- Urgent commercial calls: phone for the soonest available technician.
